en.title: Claude API Credits vs Usage Credits
en.titleCore: Claude API Credits vs Usage Credits
en.description: See which Claude plans include monthly API credits, how to claim them, and why they cannot fund extra interactive Claude Code usage.
en.body:
Claude Max and Ultra include $100 and $200 per month in Claude Platform API credits, respectively. Claude Pro includes no monthly API credit. These credits cover eligible API work in a linked Console organization. To keep using interactive Claude Code after hitting a plan limit, use separate paid usage credits if eligible.

Which Claude balance pays for what?

BalanceWhere to checkWhat it pays for
Subscription usageClaude → Settings → UsageIncluded Claude and interactive Claude Code usage, within the plan’s limits.
Monthly API creditsClaude Console → Billing, after claiming them on an eligible planClaude API, Managed Agents, Agent SDK, and Console playground usage billed to the linked organization.
Paid usage creditsClaude → Settings → UsageEligible paid usage in Claude or Claude Code after the subscription limit is reached.

Anthropic also offers pooled API credits on eligible Team plans. Check the Claude Platform credit rules and the paid usage credits guide for the current terms.

How to claim the monthly API credit

  1. In Claude on the web, open Settings → Billing on Max or Ultra. New subscribers can claim credits after seven days on an eligible plan.
  2. Under API credits, pick the Console organization that should receive them. Choose the one whose API keys your workload uses. Anthropic requires support to change the linked organization later.
  3. In that organization’s Console → Billing, check the amount and expiry. The credits refresh each billing cycle and unused amounts expire.

Worked example: one $100 Max credit, two different workloads

Suppose a developer claims the full $100 Max credit and runs an eligible workload billed to the linked Console organization. If the API bill is $65 and no other workloads draw from the balance, $35 remains for that cycle. If the developer also hits the interactive Claude Code limit, the $35 cannot pay to extend that session. They can wait for the reset or choose eligible paid extra usage. Record API spend and interactive overage as separate lines.

For unattended runs, check how the command authenticates. Anthropic says a self-run claude -p or Agent SDK workload using an API key from the linked Console organization can draw from API credits. A run authenticated with the Claude subscription draws from plan usage instead. Check the account and runtime before estimating what a job will cost. See Anthropic’s worked billing rules.

faq.question: How many monthly API credits come with Claude Pro?
faq.answer: Claude Pro does not include monthly Claude Platform API credits. Eligible Max and Ultra subscribers can claim $100 and $200 per billing cycle, respectively.

faq.question: Can I spend leftover API credits on interactive Claude Code?
faq.answer: No. Monthly API credits apply to supported API usage billed to your linked Console organization. Interactive Claude Code uses subscription usage or separate paid usage credits when enabled and eligible.

faq.question: Do unused Claude subscriber API credits roll over?
faq.answer: No. Unused included credits expire at the end of the billing cycle.
